title: Strixwolf
hook: Player-safe note: A wild adult owl-wolf with a feathered ruff, lupine body, owl face, amber hunting eyes, and a low stalking posture that turns silence into a warning.

blocks.label: Public Read
blocks.body: Lupine body with feathered ruff, owl-like facial disk, sharp muzzle, tufted ears, powerful paws, mottled grey-brown feathers and fur, and amber eyes.
